one_sentence_story: Natural sleep washes waste out of your brain by pulsing blood vessels like a slow pump every fifty seconds, while certain sleeping pills quiet that pump by half.
so_what_for_you: Never stop prescribed sleep pills on your own, but ask your doctor about behavioral sleep habits that protect your brain's natural nightly rinse cycle.
